inspected.reason: NLI classification is not relevance reranking

cross_encoder.reason: No suitable local relevance reranker present; cached NLI model is not substituted

rules.h2: Exact current alpha.85/M100/mention/uniform-weight/R3 fusion; replayed or recomposed unchanged. Prefix hashes checked before scoring.
rules.fields: Fixed weights; available-field normalized nonnegative cosine, multiplied by .5+.5*sqrt(available_weight/total_weight).
rules.evidence: Direct/explicit-name > task/problem > technical/data > presents title > short-path source > provenance title fallback. Generic bridges never copied as semantic evidence.
rules.oracle: Evaluation-only ceiling; no expected target labels enter candidate generation, evidence or reranker.
rules.costs: Atomic similarities reused from H2; evidence lookups, path expansion and scalar field scoring timed separately. Reranker comparisons count candidate score calls, not embedding dots.
rules.tail: Only top-K order changes; complete H2 tail remains untouched. Candidate recalls always use original H2 order.
rules.type_b: Historical Type B evidence retrieval unchanged; no mixed-type configuration selection.
rules.rr2: Only local relevance-trained model; no downloads or NLI substitution
rules.development: Fixed design choices, no fitting or sweeping on the repeatedly used benchmark; new-question CLI supported
